stories.title: EN DIRECT - Flambée des prix des carburants: Lecornu veut une «règle d’or» dans le budget pour que les surplus de TVA soient «restitués» aux Français

en.title: LIVE - Fuel price surge: Lecornu wants a 'golden rule' in the budget so VAT surpluses are 'returned' to the French
en.summary: The French government plans to propose a budget rule for 2027 that would ensure the state gains no financial benefit when fuel prices rise, with excess VAT revenues returned to citizens.

stories.title: Primaire socialiste : Philippe Brun «croit encore» pouvoir être candidat, malgré les accusations de violences

en.title: Socialist primary: Philippe Brun 'still believes' he can be a candidate, despite violence accusations
en.summary: A Socialist deputy facing violence allegations maintains his innocence and believes he can prove it in court while seeking to remain a primary candidate.

stories.title: Le conflit entre Trump et les grands médias franchit un cap : la Maison Blanche lance «Trump TV», une chaîne YouTube à la gloire du président

en.title: Conflict between Trump and major media reaches new level: White House launches 'Trump TV', a YouTube channel glorifying the president
en.summary: Facing boycotts from major American networks after banning certain media outlets, the U.S. president launched a YouTube channel on Monday evening to communicate directly.

stories.title: Un accord entre Paramount Skydance et douze Etats américains ouvre la voie au rachat de Warner Bros Discovery

en.title: Agreement between Paramount Skydance and twelve American states paves the way for Warner Bros Discovery acquisition
en.summary: A settlement between Paramount Skydance and multiple state attorneys general resolves legal challenges to a major media acquisition, pending federal court approval.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Philippe Brun dépose un référé pour être réintégré au PS et à la primaire de la gauche

en.title: 2027 Presidential Election: Philippe Brun Files Motion to Be Reinstated to PS and Left Primary
en.summary: A deputy from Eure has filed a legal motion seeking reinstatement to the Socialist Party and participation in the left's primary for the 2027 presidential election, whose first debate is scheduled for Wednesday evening.

stories.title: Le député Philippe Brun dépose un référé pour être réintégré au PS et à la primaire socialiste pour la présidentielle, après sa suspension pour "violences"

en.title: Deputy Philippe Brun Files Motion to Be Reinstated to PS and Socialist Primary for Presidential Election Following Suspension for "Violence"
en.summary: A deputy has filed a legal motion challenging his suspension from the Socialist Party and its primary following allegations, stating he has never committed violent acts against anyone.

stories.title: Ce n’est pas parce que Matthieu Pigasse est resté à la porte de la primaire PS qu’il ne tentera pas de rentrer par la fenêtre pour la présidentielle

en.title: Matthieu Pigasse May Seek Alternative Path to Presidential Candidacy Despite Exclusion from PS Primary
en.summary: An investment banker excluded from the Socialist primary continues positioning himself as a potential option for a unified left-wing candidacy in the presidential race eight months away.

stories.title: Carburants : Sébastien Lecornu propose d’inscrire une « règle d’or » dans le budget 2027 pour « restituer » les surplus de TVA aux Français

en.title: Fuel: Sébastien Lecornu Proposes Including a "Golden Rule" in 2027 Budget to "Return" VAT Surpluses to French Citizens
en.summary: The Prime Minister's office has proposed a budget mechanism to neutralize VAT increases from rising fuel prices and return the surplus to consumers at the pump, with implementation details to be determined.

stories.title: Flambée des prix du carburant : le gouvernement veut imposer une «règle d’or» pour redistribuer le surplus de TVA aux Français

en.title: Surge in fuel prices: government wants to impose a 'golden rule' to redistribute VAT surplus to French citizens
en.summary: The French government is proposing a golden rule to redistribute any VAT surplus generated by rising fuel prices back to citizens. Officials clarified that the government has not benefited from the price increases so far.

stories.title: Absent de la primaire «trop étroite» de la gauche, Matthieu Pigasse n’exclut pas de se présenter à la présidentielle

en.title: Absent from the left's 'too narrow' primary, Matthieu Pigasse does not rule out running for president
en.summary: Businessman Matthieu Pigasse is not participating in the left-wing primary, which he views as too restrictive. He remains open to a presidential bid and continues advocating for left-wing unity.

stories.title: Hausse du prix des carburants : le gouvernement va proposer une "règle d'or", dans le budget 2027, pour redistribuer le surplus de TVA

en.title: Rising fuel prices: government will propose a 'golden rule' in the 2027 budget to redistribute VAT surplus
en.summary: The government plans to introduce a golden rule in the 2027 budget ensuring that rising fuel prices do not generate gains for public finances. Any VAT surplus from higher fuel prices would be redistributed.

stories.title: Face à la hausse du prix des carburants, Emmanuel Macron écrit à Bruxelles pour produire davantage et assouplir les normes

en.title: Facing rising fuel prices, Emmanuel Macron writes to Brussels to produce more and relax standards
en.summary: President Macron has written to European authorities proposing to ease regulations on refining to address the fuel price crisis. These rules are currently strict due to environmental concerns and vehicle compatibility requirements.

stories.title: ▶️ Baisse de l’intérim : bon signe ou mauvaise nouvelle ?

en.title: Decline in temporary work: good sign or bad news?
en.summary: A program examines whether the decrease in temporary employment represents positive or negative economic developments.

stories.title: Réduction de la dette : « En France, le problème est politique »

en.title: Debt reduction: "In France, the problem is political"
en.summary: A former Italian Treasury official discusses how Italy has improved its deficit and suggests France has stronger economic diversification and technological capabilities than Italy.

stories.title: Groenland : le Danemark mobilise l’Otan pour encadrer les ambitions américaines

en.title: Greenland: Denmark mobilizes NATO to frame American ambitions
en.summary: Denmark, Greenland, and the United States are set to sign a security agreement, with Denmark seeking to position NATO as central to Arctic defense amid U.S. claims of seeking permanent security control over the island.

stories.title: OPINION. « Notre souveraineté alimentaire passe par une nouvelle relation à l’eau et par un partage juste et démocratique de la ressource »

en.title: OPINION. "Our food sovereignty depends on a new relationship with water and fair, democratic sharing of the resource"
en.summary: Water has shifted from being viewed as an unlimited resource to becoming strategically precious and critical to agriculture, industry, health, and territorial planning.

stories.title: Extinction de la 2G : téléphones, ascenseurs, voitures… 2 millions de SIM restent encore dépendantes

en.title: 2G shutdown: phones, elevators, cars... 2 million SIM cards still dependent
en.summary: Orange is discontinuing 2G service in Nice on September 22, with a complete network shutdown by October 20. Approximately 1.22 million SIM cards in phones and tablets remain limited to 2G technology, while alarms, intercoms, heating systems, elevator emergency calls, and some vehicles also depend on the outdated network.
